examples.fr: Il s'est fait mal au derrière en tombant de l'échelle.
examples.en: He hurt his behind falling off the ladder.

examples.fr: L'enfant cachait le cadeau derrière son dos pour faire une surprise.
examples.en: The child was hiding the gift behind his back to give a surprise.

reasons: entry is a noun (m, 'behind/rear') but neither example used 'derrière' as a noun; replaced first example with the nominal sense (le derrière = the rear/buttocks)
